# `audit` operations

1 operation. Generated from `assets/operations.json`; [all areas](README.md).

### audit.list

**Audit log**

The newest entries of the audit log, newest first: every call through tomaccoctl call or MCP that may change something, and every call a guard refused, with the channel, the client's name, the operation, its arguments with secrets masked, how it ended and when. more is true when older entries match too.

Annotations: read-only, idempotent, closed world.

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Details |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `limit` | integer |  | `50` | 1 to 1000 |
| `operation` | string |  |  | non-empty, up to 128 characters; Only operations whose name starts with this |
| `channel` | string |  |  | one of `mcp`, `cli` |
| `client` | string |  |  | non-empty, up to 100 characters; Only calls from the MCP client of this name |
| `failed` | boolean |  | `false` | Only calls that failed or were refused |
| `since` | number |  |  | at least 0; Only calls at or after this time, in seconds since 1970 |

```sh
tomaccoctl call audit.list
```
